name: Shanfu
source:
A small adventurer with a huge axe and overwhelming power. An old acquaintance of Kazuto from his adventuring days. Kazuto was a mentor to her when she was first starting out, and she is very found of him. Karin takes a liking to her, and invites her to join the Dungeon.

[spoiler]
She is actually a mixed-blood of human and demon. Afraid of people learning of her demon blood, she always travelled around and never made close connections. Meeting the residents of the Dungeon, she realizes that no one here would judge her for her blood and she would have a home.
[/spoiler]
translation:
A small adventurer with a huge axe and overwhelming power. An old acquaintance of Kazuto from his adventuring days. Kazuto was a mentor to her when she was first starting out, and she is very found of him. Karin takes a liking to her, and invites her to join the Dungeon.

[spoiler]
She is actually a mixed-blood of human and demon. Afraid of people learning of her demon blood, she always travelled around and never made close connections. Meeting the residents of the Dungeon, she realizes that no one here would judge her for her blood and she would have a home.
[/spoiler]
